question: What does a visitor see when they open a link that has expired?

options.answer: A page that says the link expired, with no note content and no owner name.
options.rationale: Matches how revoked links behave today.
options.yields: WHEN a visitor opens an expired link THE public route SHALL return 410 and the expired page

options.answer: A 404, the same as a link that never existed.
options.rationale: Hides that the link existed; the past incident (R9) was about leaking that.
options.yields: WHEN a visitor opens an expired link THE public route SHALL return 404
